page_text:
' IJ 

INSTITUTE  FOR  JUSTICE 

July 2,  2019 

Via Electronic Filing and Overnight Mail 
Hon. Scott S.  Harris, Clerk of Court 
Supreme Court of the United States 
1 First Street, NE 
Washington, DC 20543 

Re:  Kendra Espinoza, et al.  v.  Montana Dept.  of Revenue, et al., 

Docket No.  18-1195 

Dear Mr. Harris: 

Pursuant to U.S. Supreme Court Rule 30(4), Petitioners Kendra Espinoza, et 

al.,  respectfully request a  30-day extension, up to and including September 11, 
2019, to file  their Brief on the Merits and the Joint Appendix. 

Certiorari was granted on June 28,  2019 and Petitioners Brief on the Merits 

and the Joint Appendix are currently due on August 12,  2019. 

This extension is requested because Counsel of Record for Petitioners, Erica 
Smith, has four work trips in North Dakota, New Jersey, and Tenneessee over the 
next month, with additional work travel expected.  These trips currently include an 
evidentiary hearing on a motion for preliminary injunction in a  First Amendment 
case on July 30,  2019 and two additional court hearings.  Ms. Smith will be the 
primary author of the Brief on the Merits. 

Respectfully, 

~~ 

Erica Smith 
Counsel for Petitioners 

cc: 

Daniel J. Whyte, Counsel for Respondents 
(via email: DWhyte@mt.gov)
